source_window.dataset: Listed Buildings as polygons - Open Data Hub download index

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for an Exeter listed building with explicit type/use evidence. The selected Historic England Open Data Hub download page confirms the official Listed Buildings as polygons product, updated 6 October 2026 and distributed under the Open Government Licence, but this source window is product-level download metadata and exposes no individual Exeter feature, polygon coordinates, or record-bound type/use payload; therefore no individual building record was accepted.
